evidence: Labeled 'UTXO Db and Indexes' and heavily modifies src/coins.*, src/txdb.*, src/dbwrapper.*, and chainstate error propagation.
rationale: Fixes an issue where typed deserialization errors in CDBWrapper::Read() returned false, causing corrupted data to masquerade as missing keys, while LevelDB read errors threw without running error callbacks. It also removes the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher indirection layer, substantially simplifying the coins view stack.
